title: Quick Spring Braised Filipino Broad Beans Tagine
description: This dish is inspired by the flavors of the Mediterranean and Filipino cuisine, featuring the freshness of spring broad beans in a flavorful and aromatic braise. It's perfect for a cozy evening meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Sauté the onion until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the broad beans, coconut milk, fish sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, black pepper, and chili flakes. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the tagine and cook for 15 minutes, or until the broad beans are tender.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.
Serve warm over rice or with crusty bread.
Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
This dish is best served immediately, but it can be refrigerated for up to a day and reheated.
You can also serve this dish with steamed vegetables or as a side dish.
This recipe is best made with fresh broad beans, but frozen or canned beans can be substituted in a pinch.
This recipe can be made in a Dutch oven or other heavy pot if a tagine is not available.
